generated_environment.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Genii survey premium consumer website sculptural environment, landscape 1536x1024. Create a beautifully lit high-end 3D product campaign still life on a clean pure-white studio background. This is an EMPTY SUPPORTING STAGE for an existing lilac mascot to be composited later by code. Scene: a low, very wide lavender transparent glass plinth near the bottom center, a large organically folded translucent violet glass ribbon curling around the sides but leaving the entire middle upper half empty, one small polished chrome sphere on the lower left, a small inflated translucent lilac five-petal flower object on the right edge, and subtle refracted sunlight caustics across the white floor. The palette is white and confident lilac/violet with silver highlights, not a washed-out gray fog. Give glass edges crisp rich violet refraction, bright clear highlights, real material thickness and contact shadows. The shapes feel joyful, touchable and contemporary. Camera frontal at slight elevated angle. Center 45% wide by upper 60% high of image remains plain white, empty for the existing character and with no object covering that area. Ribbon can enter from lower-left and arc up the right edge, not a generic complete circle or glass donut. Full composition at generous margins, nothing cropped on sides. Premium art direction, beautiful physical materials, clean contours, high definition, no mist, no blur, no grain. Absolutely no text, no UI, no symbols, no eyes, no faces, no mascot, no logos, no watermark, no dark background. The result must feel like a cheerful sculptural set for a refined white-and-purple consumer survey.
